1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Suri Rumah (Perbekalan) (No. 2) 2024.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2025

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi dua puluh juta dua ratus tujuh

belas ribu ringgit (RM20,217,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial

Suri Rumah bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Skim Keselamatan Sosial Suri Rumah

bagi tahun 2025 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang dinyatakan

dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 9,725,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 8,004,000

 Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 958,000

Perbelanjaan lain 960,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 570,000

JUMLAH 20,217,000

Dibuat 12 Disember 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/1/31/7(6); PN(PU2)765/JLD.2]

 SIM CHEE KEONG

 Menteri Sumber Manusia

HOUSEWIVES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2022

HOUSEWIVES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) (NO. 2) REGULATIONS 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 54(1) of the

Housewives' Social Security Act 2022 [Act 838], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Housewives' Social Security (Supply)

(No. 2) Regulations 2024.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2025

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding twenty million two hundred and seventeen

thousand ringgit (RM20,217,000) from the Housewives' Social Security Fund for

the expenditure on administration of the Housewives' Social Security Scheme for

the year 2025 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 9,725,000

Supplies and services 8,004,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 958,000

Other expenditures 960,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 570,000

TOTAL 20,217,000

Made 12 December 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/1/31/7(6); PN(PU2)765/JLD.2]

 SIM CHEE KEONG

Minister of Human Resources
